# pnpm.install installs a workspace from its committed lockfile, linking
# `workspace:` dependencies, and reruns only when a manifest changes.
[!exec:pnpm] skip

bit
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
stdout '│ path=/\S*/work/node_modules$'
exists node_modules/.modules.yaml
exists packages/app/node_modules/lib/package.json
cmp pnpm-lock.yaml lock.orig

bit
! stdout '✔ ok'

cp other.package.json packages/other/package.json
bit
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'

bit --clean
! exists node_modules
! exists packages/app/node_modules

# A manifest the lockfile doesn't match fails a frozen install, and an
# unfrozen one updates the lockfile.
cp app.package.json packages/app/package.json
! bit deps
stdout 'deps │ Error: ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE'
stderr 'target ''deps'' apply failed'
cp BUILD.unfrozen BUILD.bit
# pnpm freezes the lockfile by default when CI is set, which `frozen = false`
# overrides.
env CI=true
bit deps
stdout 'deps ▶ pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile$'
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
grep '^ +other:\n +specifier: workspace:\*' pnpm-lock.yaml
exists packages/app/node_modules/other/package.json

-- BUILD.unfrozen --
deps = pnpm.install {
  frozen = false
}

-- BUILD.bit --
deps = pnpm.install {}

show = exec {
  command = "echo path=#{deps.path}"
  inputs = []
}

-- lock.orig --
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .: {}

  packages/app:
    dependencies:
      lib:
        specifier: workspace:*
        version: link:../lib

  packages/lib: {}

  packages/other: {}
-- pnpm-lock.yaml --
lockfileVersion: '9.0'

settings:
  autoInstallPeers: true
  excludeLinksFromLockfile: false

importers:

  .: {}

  packages/app:
    dependencies:
      lib:
        specifier: workspace:*
        version: link:../lib

  packages/lib: {}

  packages/other: {}
-- pnpm-workspace.yaml --
packages:
  - "packages/*"
-- package.json --
{ "name": "root", "private": true }
-- packages/lib/package.json --
{ "name": "lib", "version": "1.0.0", "main": "index.js" }
-- packages/lib/index.js --
module.exports = "lib";
-- packages/app/package.json --
{ "name": "app", "version": "1.0.0", "dependencies": { "lib": "workspace:*" } }
-- packages/other/package.json --
{ "name": "other", "version": "1.0.0" }
-- app.package.json --
{ "name": "app", "version": "1.0.0", "dependencies": { "lib": "workspace:*", "other": "workspace:*" } }
-- other.package.json --
{ "name": "other", "version": "1.0.0", "description": "changed" }
